final: 2017-01 through 2017-12 one frozen rolling evaluation of selected candidate; original cached pooled28 baseline
holiday90: 90-day calibration; independent Cq holiday/nonholiday rank references, risk threshold and CQR score quantile when at least24 Cq hours in group; otherwise pooled90 fallback. No change to point/scale feature schema (holiday already included).
selection: Choose among two candidates using development only. Eligible if holiday/nonholiday retained PICP>=0.905 and nonholiday rejection<=baseline+0.02; minimize holiday rejection then retained width then name. If none eligible choose smallest summed coverage deficit then holiday rejection then name, explicitly mark development gate failed. Selection is research-only, never promotion.
calendar: US federal observed dates, using existing BDG2 wall-clock date convention
limitation: 2017 already measured in prior work; not a never-seen blind test. New candidate decisions frozen from2016 only. Hourly coverage not independent day samples.
